about_the_game:
A philosophical horror experience in the Alps: As Friedrich Nietzsche confronts his own shadow, he becomes lost between layers of reality.

Wander through the mist-shrouded Alps as Friedrich Nietzsche in this first-person exploration game, haunted by the wind-scattered pages of your final manuscript. Your shadow has taken form, speaking to you with sarcastic provocation, mercilessly exposing your contradictions and suppressed thoughts. What begins as a journey through flowered meadows transforms into a nightmare of twisted realities and philosophical terror.

As you collect the fragments of your work, traverse the breathtaking Alpine paths where Nietzsche himself once walked and developed his revolutionary ideas.

But this journey conceals deeper layers of reality. The truth of your existence may be more disturbing than any philosophical abyss you've contemplated. Are you ready to confront what lies beyond the veil of perception?

KEY FEATURES

  • LIVE PHILOSOPHY, DON'T JUST READ IT Experience Nietzsche's profound concepts—Eternal Return, Will to Power, Death of God—through an immersive journey.

  • IMMERSE IN PERIOD MUSIC Listen to Chopin, Bach, Wagner and other composers beloved by Nietzsche as you explore the philosophical landscape.

  • CONFRONT YOUR SHADOW Engage in provocative dialogues with your own shadow, a manifestation that challenges your beliefs and exposes your deepest contradictions.

  • EXPLORE THE LIMINAL SPACES Navigate through Alps that transform into uncanny realms inspired by Backrooms and SCP Foundation lore.

  • UNCOVER MEMORY FRAGMENTS Collect unique manuscript pages across three distinct regions, each revealing pieces of Nietzsche's life and thoughts.

  • DISCOVER MULTILAYERED MYSTERIES Unravel subtle clues suggesting this entire experience may be something far more unsettling than it first appears.

  • EXPERIENCE EXISTENTIAL HORROR Interact with the environment in meaningful ways—smell flowers, touch water, stir leaves—triggering philosophical reflections that deepen the existential dread.

Dive into this thought-provoking philosophical horror experience where the greatest terror may be the truth waiting beyond the veil of your perception.

Created by a team of PhD-holding philosophy historians, ensuring an authentic and intellectually stimulating experience.
